title: Fixed-Price kWh on Block and Index and Fixed Structures - Pass-Through Cycle
content:
*Scope: Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts. Subject: fixed-price line corrections: fixed-price kWh.*

The fixed-price kWh follow the structure and the cycle: on a block and index contract, a cycle of fewer than 28 billing days carries the block kWh per cycle multiplied by its billing days and divided by 30, and any other cycle carries the block kWh per cycle whatever the metered kWh; on any other structure the fixed-price kWh are the cycle's metered kWh, the kWh on all of the cycle's energy lines together.

The block kWh per cycle is the quoted block shown on the contract; the billing days are those shown on the cycle's lines.

| Structure | Energy priced as | Cycle | Fixed-price kWh |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | fixed block plus index balance | fewer than 28 billing days | block kWh per cycle multiplied by the billing days, divided by 30 |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | fixed block plus index balance | 28 billing days or more | block kWh per cycle |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | index plus adder | any | metered kWh |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through | fixed | any | metered kWh |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through | fixed | any | metered kWh |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In | fixed | any | metered kWh |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In Renewable | fixed | any | metered kWh |

## Cases (hypothetical, block of 250000 kWh per cycle)

- Block and Index, 25 billing days: 250000 multiplied by 25, divided by 30, that is 208333.33 kWh, carried unrounded.
- Block and Index, 28 billing days with 236000 kWh metered: 250000 kWh.
- Block and Index, 31 billing days with 310000 kWh metered: 250000 kWh.
- Fixed All-In, 31 billing days with 420000 kWh metered: 420000 kWh.
